turns.prompt_text: What kinds of questions can I ask about a page? chrome://newtab/
turns.response_html:
You can ask me a wide variety of questions to help you understand, summarize, or utilize the information on the webpage you are viewing.

Here are the main types of questions I can answer:

  • Summarization: "What are the key takeaways from this article?" or "Give me a 3-bullet summary of this page."
  • Specific Information Retrieval: "What is the price listed for the product?" or "When is the event mentioned on this page taking place?"
  • Explanation & Simplification: "Explain the scientific concept in the second paragraph like I'm 5" or "What does this code snippet do?"
  • Formatting & Extraction: "Turn the ingredients listed here into a grocery checklist" or "Create a table comparing the specs listed in this review."
  • Translation: "Translate the first section into Spanish."
  • Connection: "How does this opinion piece relate to [Current Event]?"

Note on your current view: You are currently on the New Tab page, which is mostly a dashboard with shortcuts to sites like YouTube, Gmail, and GitHub. My page-reading features work best once you navigate to a content-rich site, such as a news article, a recipe blog, or one of the YouTube videos in your shortcuts (like the "Past Lives" trailer).

Would you like to navigate to one of your open tabs or shortcuts so we can try it out?
